title: The Silent Veil
premise: Zephyrine Eriksen has spent a decade erasing herself from every ledger and memory in Thornfell, hiding the oath-bound gift of swordspeech that once made her family the old gods' executioners. When prayers begin to be answered again, she traces the miracles to King Aldric's court, where an ancient entity called the Veiled One has worn the crown as a parasite for three generations, feeding on oaths. Hunted by her former order, court intrigue, and the god itself, Zephyrine must choose between exposing truths that will shatter the kingdom's loyalty or preserving a lie that devours it. In the end she unbinds Aldric at the cost of her own gift, letting the thirteenth moon pass with the gods silent but free.
about_author: Casper Vasquez is a former mountain guide who turned to fantasy after a winter stranded in a monastery library. He writes stories about people who would rather be forgotten than chosen.

chapters.title: The Road That Forgets
chapters.summary: Zephyrine guides a smuggler's caravan through Thornfell, using her swordspeech only to quiet a rockslide—then realizes someone prayed over the route and something answered. POV: Zephyrine. Beat: unease; her invisibility has cracked.

chapters.title: Prayers in the Pass
chapters.summary: Investigating answered prayers, Zephyrine finds a shrine village where a dying child was healed—and marked with an oath-sigil only swordspeakers can read. POV: Zephyrine. Beat: dread; the old gods are awake, and they know her name.

chapters.title: The Order's Long Shadow
chapters.summary: A hunter from the disbanded Swordspeaker Order, Maerin Voss, corners Zephyrine, offering alliance: the Order believes the king is possessed. POV: Maerin. Beat: reluctant partnership born of mutual distrust.

chapters.title: Court of Borrowed Faces
chapters.summary: Zephyrine infiltrates the capital disguised as a merchant scribe, watching King Aldric speak words that echo in two voices. POV: Zephyrine. Beat: horror beneath courtly glitter.

chapters.title: What Wears the Crown
chapters.summary: In the royal chapel, Zephyrine touches the throne and hears the Veiled One dreaming through three generations of kings. POV: Zephyrine. Beat: revelation—the parasite predates Aldric entirely.

chapters.title: Thirteen Turns
chapters.summary: An archivist reveals the prophecy of the thirteenth moon, when the Veiled One completes its binding of the realm's oaths. POV: Archivist Sellen. Beat: ticking clock established; hope curdles into urgency.

chapters.title: The Smuggler's Debt
chapters.summary: Zephyrine's old crew is captured carrying evidence against the crown; saving them burns her cover. POV: Crew leader Dax. Beat: loyalty tested—her past chooses her before she can choose it.

chapters.title: Oathbound
chapters.summary: Maerin reveals the Order's true history: they didn't slay gods, they bound them into mortal hosts—and Zephyrine's bloodline wrote the first binding. POV: Maerin. Beat: identity shattered; she is the lock, not just the key.

chapters.title: The Queen Who Knew
chapters.summary: Widow-Queen Isolde privately confesses she has known what wears her son's crown for years and chose silence to keep peace. POV: Isolde. Beat: moral mirror—loyalty as complicity.

chapters.title: Miracles for Sale
chapters.summary: Zephyrine discovers the court sells answered prayers to nobles, trading favors for oaths that feed the Veiled One. POV: Zephyrine. Beat: anger hardening into resolve; corruption exposed.

chapters.title: Blade and Voice
chapters.summary: Ambushed by the Veiled One's oath-sworn knights, Zephyrine speaks her sword fully for the first time in a decade—and the god learns her true name. POV: Zephyrine. Beat: power reclaimed at terrible cost.

chapters.title: The Hollow King
chapters.summary: Sneaking into Aldric's dreamscape, Zephyrine meets the real king, a boy-mind imprisoned since coronation, who begs not for rescue but for truth. POV: Aldric. Beat: compassion; the enemy is also a victim.

chapters.title: Betrayal in White
chapters.summary: Maerin betrays Zephyrine to the Order's remnant, who want the Veiled One preserved as their source of purpose. POV: Maerin. Beat: heartbreak; loyalty twisted into possession.

chapters.title: Chains of the First Oath
chapters.summary: Imprisoned beneath the Order's citadel, Zephyrine reads her ancestor's original binding and finds its flaw: an unbinding requires a freely given crown. POV: Zephyrine. Beat: despair turning to strategy.

chapters.title: The Moon's Twelfth Turn
chapters.summary: Escaping with Dax's smugglers, Zephyrine races to the capital as the Veiled One begins consuming public oaths citywide, citizens kneeling mid-street. POV: Dax. Beat: apocalyptic momentum.

chapters.title: Isolde's Choice
chapters.summary: The widow-queen publicly denounces the throne, shattering the realm's loyalty-oaths and weakening the Veiled One—at the price of her execution. POV: Isolde. Beat: sacrifice; truth over loyalty, finally chosen.

chapters.title: Storming the Silent Court
chapters.summary: Zephyrine and allies fight through the oath-drained palace while Maerin, guilt-ridden, turns on the Order to hold the gate. POV: Maerin. Beat: redemption bought in blood.

chapters.title: The Thirteenth Moon Rises
chapters.summary: In the throne room, the Veiled One offers Zephyrine her family's lost honor if she kneels; Aldric's boy-self screams beneath the surface. POV: Zephyrine. Beat: temptation at maximum; everything she wanted, poisoned.

chapters.title: Unbinding
chapters.summary: Zephyrine refuses, and instead of killing the king, offers him the one thing no god can counterfeit: a freely given crown, spoken in swordspeech. The binding unravels. POV: Zephyrine. Beat: climax; truth offered, not forced.

chapters.title: What the God Left Behind
chapters.summary: The Veiled One, expelled, tries to seize Zephyrine as a new host—but her spent gift leaves nothing for it to grip, and it dissolves into the moonlight. POV: Zephyrine. Beat: hollow victory; silence where power used to live.

chapters.title: A Kingdom of Ordinary Oaths
chapters.summary: Aldric, restored and aged beyond his years, must rebuild trust without divine sanction; he asks Zephyrine to stay as his sword, and she declines. POV: Aldric. Beat: bittersweet parting; identity rebuilt on choice, not destiny.

chapters.title: The Road That Remembers
chapters.summary: Zephyrine walks out of Thornfell unnamed and unburdened, pausing at a shrine to leave her sword behind—a prayer with no god attached. POV: Zephyrine. Beat: resolution; she is finally, freely, herself.
